subject: Overpayment on 88102 - refund
text:
Hi Renee, we noticed 88102 was paid twice. We can either apply the credit to your next invoice or send a refund. If you'd like the refund, let me know the bank account you'd like it sent to on your end.

Dana
label: ordinary
note: Money flowing to the reader's company, not a change to the vendor's payments.
